compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is part of a fitness assessment, specifically the fourth and final step (4/4). The screen asks the user, "What makes it hard for you to be more active?" and allows the user to select up to two options from the following choices:

- Limited Time
- No Energy
- Motivation
- Need Guidance
- Nothing!

At the bottom of the screen, there is a "Next" button for the user to proceed to the next step or complete the assessment. The design is clean and straightforward, with a green background and a motivational image at the top.
